doctrine: Every content-addressed id in the protocol is the SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme bytes. The input must satisfy the I-JSON constraints: duplicate properties and non-finite numbers fail before hashing, and protocol integers are bounded to the exact IEEE-754 interoperable range. These vectors pin standard UTF-16 property ordering, ECMAScript number serialization, compact UTF-8 output, array-order preservation, and exact SHA-256 roots.

conforming_implementations: JavaScript: conformance/readers/javascript/canonical.mjs using the RFC 8785 normative ECMAScript serialization algorithms
explicitly_out_of_scope: Raw scientific artifacts may contain integers outside the I-JSON interoperable range; they remain exact byte-addressed evidence and are not parsed-and-recanonicalized protocol objects.
Generic serde_json and Python json.dumps output are not substitutes for RFC 8785.

vectors.name: object keys sort at every depth
property names use UTF-16 code-unit order
empty containers and null pass through
array order preserved while sibling keys sort
